title: Break Through Before It Arrives
setup: Black's king on e4 is coming for your pawns, and your own king is too far away to help. You have exactly one move that wins.
hint: A black pawn only leaves its file to capture. Which push can be taken from both sides, and what does each capture leave open?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{g6}} offers the middle pawn to both black pawns beside it. Every other move loses, because Black's king simply eats your pawns.

Say Black takes with {{fxg6}}: {{h6}} offers a second pawn. Now one of yours gets through whatever Black does. Take on h6, and the f-pawn runs to f8 before the king can reach it. Leave it, and your h-pawn takes on g7 and queens.
